description: Create a new messaging project (a draft send). Requires the owning organization, a name, protocol (sms or mms), sending phone number IDs, contact list IDs, and the message text. For a triggered project (no contact list; each recipient gets one message when the trigger fires) pass type "triggered" and a trigger instead of contact_list_ids; start it with start_project after test_project. For channel=10dlc also pass brand_id and campaign_id; for channel=toll-free pass toll_free_verification_id. Creating a project does not send messages by itself. A 409 `LIST_ANALYSIS_IN_PROGRESS` means a contact list is still being analyzed; wait until `get_contact_list` shows `analysis.status` `complete`, then retry.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

contact_list_ids.description: Contact list IDs to send to. Required unless type is triggered.

link_tracking_destination_url.description: Destination URL for tracked links. May embed the selected link parameter via a placeholder named after it (e.g. ?utm_content=xyzd_{linkid}); without a placeholder the parameter is appended as its own query pair. May also be exactly https://{<link_tracking_param_field>} (e.g. https://{custom_url}) to send each recipient to the URL in that contact field; then link_tracking_fallback_url is required

link_tracking_fallback_url.description: Redirect for recipients whose link_tracking_param_field value is empty or not a valid URL. Required when link_tracking_destination_url is a whole-URL placeholder; rejected otherwise

link_tracking_param_field.description: Contact field carried on tracking-link redirects (phone or a custom-field name)

opt_out_footer_enabled.description: Whether the STOP=END opt-out footer is appended to every message (default true)

trigger.description: When a triggered project or campaign adds a recipient. source "api": recipients arrive from add_project_recipient / add_email_campaign_recipient or the inbound hook URL. source "donation": a gift from a connected WinRed or Anedot list (donation.integrations is required). source "event": something that happens in another project or campaign (event.event and event.sources are required). delay_minutes (0-43200) delays each send; reentry is {mode: "once"} (default) or {mode: "repeat", min_gap_hours: 1-8760}.

sources.description: "any" (never includes another triggered item) or {ids: [...]}: project IDs for text_* events, email campaign IDs for email_* events

type.description: Project type. Defaults to broadcast. Triggered requires trigger and takes no list IDs.

name: create_project
